profile.title: Profile
profile.text: University Lecturer, Subject Leader and Global Sourcing Director with more than 27 years of buyer-side industry leadership across multinational corporations (MNCs) and over four years of undergraduate and postgraduate teaching experience. She brings deep practitioner expertise in international buyer-supplier governance, cross-border sourcing strategy, brand and product execution for global retail markets, factory compliance and production operations, connecting rigorous academic frameworks with real-world industry cases, simulations and executive networks.

objective.title: Academic & doctoral candidacy objective
objective.org: School of Business, International University (IU), VNU-HCM
objective.text: Seeking an opportunity to contribute as a faculty member while pursuing doctoral studies (PhD) at the School of Business, International University (IU), VNU-HCM. Committed to enriching undergraduate and graduate courses in Global Supply Chain, International Business and Strategic Sourcing, strengthening university-industry linkages, and advancing empirical research on how CSR and ESG criteria shape international buyers' supplier selection decisions in Vietnam's export garment supply chain.
